tenderSchedule.title: SELECTION OF DPR CONSULTANT
tenderSchedule.description: FOR SELECTION OF DPR CONSULTANT FOR DEVELOPMENT OF INTEGRATED AIRSTRIP-CUM-HELIPORT AT CHIKKAMAGALURU AND HELIPORTS AT HAMPI AND MADIKERI, KARNATAKA
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation

tenderAddress.blockNumber: KSIIDC, 4th Floor, East Wing, No 49, Race Course Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
KSIIDC reserves the right to accept or reject any of the tenders without assigning any reasons thereof
No Interest will be paid for EMD (Bid Security)

All required original documents shall be scanned and uploaded in e-procurement. Failure to upload any document in e-proc will be considered as non responsive. The Bidders shall submit all the original documents uploaded as per RFP conditions.
Any document uploading shall be made in the corresponding parts only as specified in the RFP document.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have relevant experience in at least two (2) projects involving Master Planning, Detailed Project Report (DPR) preparation, Detailed Engineering for aviation infrastructure projects (such as airports, airstrips, passenger terminal buildings, cargo terminal buildings, air traffic control (ATC) towers, and aircraft maintenance hangars) and Heliports within the last ten (10) years. Each of these projects must have had a total project cost of not less than Rs 100 crores and must have been completed.

Experience in Master Planning, DPR preparation, and Detailed Engineering for at least one infrastructure project (such as roads, bridges, industrial facilities, public buildings, or utilities) with a total project cost of not less than Rs 150 crores, completed within the last five (5) years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Approach and Methodology presentation and related documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Firms Turnover The bidders shall have a minimum average turnover of Rs.5 Crores over the last 3 financial years (FY 23 -24, FY 24-25 and FY 25-26).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
